Executive Leadership Profile

Arch. Pravin Eknath Khade

Founder & Principal Architect • K Arch Architects

Architectural Philosophy & Vision

"We do not opt for standardized architecture with pre-conceived notions. Instead, we develop design solutions that integrate form and function, contemplating architecture and landscape best suited to each project while surpassing conventional construction constraints."

Professional Background

Ar. Pravin Eknath Khade is a distinguished Mumbai architect who founded K Arch Architects in 2012. With near two decades of domain experience in the high-density real estate and urban development environment of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Ar. Pravin has pioneered transformative design methodologies that harmonize statutory feasibility with landmark architectural distinction.

Under his direction, K Arch Architects has designed and executed over 90+ iconic projects encompassing soaring residential skyscrapers (30 to 60+ storeys), corporate business parks, integrated master-planned townships, and complex society redevelopment projects under DCPR-2034, MHADA, and SRA regulations.

Key Areas of Specialization

  • High-Rise Aerodynamic Design: Wind vortex mitigation, optimized floor plate efficiency, and shear wall structural coordination for 35+ storey towers.
  • Statutory Municipal Approvals: Extensive expertise in Mumbai development control regulations, environmental clearances, and civil authority liaisoning.
  • Sustainable Master Planning: Macro land-use zoning, infrastructure integration, and climatological feasibility for large-scale townships.
  • Society Redevelopment: FSI optimization, rehabilitation design, and developer profitability models.
